title: Amendment to the Fourth Schedule to the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (explanatory note on draft s.11A notification)
note: Scanned, 1 page. Government note, not the notification itself: corrects the model fee for Rs.10-20 crore claims (over and above Rs.1,00,00,000 -> Rs.10,00,00,000), with effect from 23 Oct 2015; draft laid in LS 19 Jul 2017, RS 21 Jul 2017 under s.11A(2). Final Gazette notification not yet located. Found via legislative.gov.in search (browser), 2026-10-21.
